meta.name: QuickBooks Sync Overview
meta.tagline: Sync health KPIs with an activity log and a swap-in field-mappings configurator, both sliced by object type.
meta.description: Shows ops teams the state of their QuickBooks sync for this customer — what's synced, what failed, and exactly why. They can flip to a mapping view to configure how QB fields line up with HubSpot properties. — Multi-View: aggregate Statistics + dual-mode (activity ↔ mappings) DataTable sliced by object type.
